name: @aiti-ai/aiti-backup
description: Snapshot backup for large pi-web state data — hard-link incremental snapshots, out-of-process execution, crash-safe temp files, keepCount rotation. Complements aiti-configs, which versions small configs in git.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: pi-web 数据备份扩展（state 层快照：硬链接增量 + 保留轮转 + 源严格只读；与 aiti-configs 互补）
